description: Implement a function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number. The function has iContract preconditions (n must be non-negative) and postconditions (result equals the sum of the previous two Fibonacci numbers for n >= 2).
test_cases:
assert fibonacci(0) == 0
assert fibonacci(1) == 1
assert fibonacci(5) == 5
assert fibonacci(10) == 55
print('All tests passed!')
